name: basic_create_pr
assertions: triggers the pr skill
creates a draft PR by default
pushes branch to remote if not already pushed
uses gh pr create command

name: open_pull_request_trigger
input: open a pull request for this branch
assertions: triggers the pr skill from natural language
detects current branch name
creates draft PR by default
generates title and body from commits

name: ready_flag_draft_to_ready
assertions: triggers the pr skill with --ready flag
converts existing draft PR to ready for review
uses gh pr ready command
does NOT create a new PR if one already exists

name: update_existing_pr
assertions: triggers the pr skill with --update flag
updates the existing PR title or body
does NOT create a new PR
uses gh pr edit command

name: fill_from_commits
assertions: triggers the pr skill with --fill flag
auto-fills PR title and body from commit messages
passes --fill to gh pr create
creates draft PR by default

name: draft_default_behavior
input: make a pull request with my changes
assertions: triggers the pr skill
creates PR as draft by default without explicit flag
includes --draft flag in gh pr create
user must explicitly use --ready to mark as non-draft

name: negative_fix_pr_comments
assertions: does NOT trigger the pr skill
triggers the pr-fix skill instead
recognized as a remediation task not a creation task

name: negative_review_pr_comments
assertions: does NOT trigger the pr skill
triggers the review-comments skill instead
recognized as a review task not a creation task

name: push_before_create
input: create a PR for my local changes
assertions: triggers the pr skill
checks if branch has been pushed to remote
pushes branch with -u flag if not already pushed
creates PR only after branch is on remote
creates draft PR by default

name: custom_target_branch
assertions: triggers the pr skill with target branch argument
uses develop as the base branch instead of main
passes --base develop to gh pr create
creates draft PR by default
